result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on the Riemann zeta function: a contour-integral representation and functional equation, a theta-function (elliptic modulus K, K') representation of $\Pi(s/2-1)\pi^{-s/2}\zeta(s)$, Stirling-type asymptotics on the critical line $s=\tfrac12+ti$, and a saddle-point equation for $x^s/(e^x-1)$.
